description: Walk a PNG file's chunk stream directly from its bytes to report every chunk's type, byte offset, data length, and whether its stored CRC-32 matches the data, plus the decoded IHDR header and a handful of common ancillary chunks (tEXt, pHYs, gAMA, tIME, acTL). No pixel decoding, and zTXt/iTXt text is listed but not zlib-inflated.

png_base64.description: Base64-encoded PNG file bytes, optionally prefixed with a data: URL scheme

name: read_png_chunks
